whyItMatters: Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) computes MD5 in ruby, whose collisions defeat any security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload) with Digest::SHA256.hexdigest wherever the digest protects passwords, signatures, or untrusted data.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified Digest::MD5.hexdigest(payload), and security digests verify under the replacement.
